summary: This Form 8-K filed by Stoke Therapeutics, Inc. on June 30, 2026, discloses operational updates under Items 7.01 and 8.01, announcing the completion of enrollment of 162 patients into the Phase 3 EMPEROR study of zorevunersen for Dravet syndrome, with a data readout expected in Q3 2027 and plans for a rolling NDA submission starting Q1 2027. There are no M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation elements; the filing constitutes a routine clinical-trial progress report that does not trigger a special-situation classification.
